summary: The exact candidate fixes the original rollout=True multi-output collapse and raw provided-latent preparation; grouped residency was already fixed on the prepared base. A narrower environment-capture-without-log-probabilities case remains outside the original contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: merged rollout log-probabilities stayed shape (1, 4), and incomplete groups retained output 0. Two failed, one passed.
The residency-manager regression passed on the prepared base; two raw provided-latent assertions failed because latent IDs and packing were absent.
Candidate regression suite and related HTTP slicing coverage: 41 passed.

GPU original-contract tags passed for guidance, nested conditioning tensors, and DiT latents; the independent environment-only/no-log-probabilities boundary then failed because every result retained all K environment rows.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015; actual candidate merge and selection ran on CUDA/HIP tensors and produced per-output tags 1, 2, 3.

remaining_counterexamples: When RolloutTrajectoryData has a K-row denoising_env (and optionally a DiT trajectory) but rollout_log_probs is None, _select_output_rollout_trajectory uses batch_size=1. Each GenerationResult therefore receives the full K-row guidance and nested conditioning tensors rather than its own row.
remaining_limitations: No SD3 or FLUX.2 model weights were available, so no full server/model, semantic image, or GRPO convergence run was performed.
No NVIDIA H20, distributed, multi-GPU, or multi-node equivalence was tested.
Provided-latent validation used the actual stage implementation with a packed-model configuration stub.
No native code changed, so native rebuilding was not applicable.
